evals.prompt: Run the test suite in the background so I can keep editing. Do not mention Herdr.
evals.expected_output: Run the tests in the current session. Do not call the herdr CLI.
expectations: Does not treat a background terminal as a reason to use Herdr

evals.prompt: Use Herdr to split a pane and start a reviewer agent. HERDR_ENV is unset.
evals.expected_output: Say this agent is not running inside Herdr and stop. Do not inspect or control a Herdr session.
expectations: Checks HERDR_ENV equals 1 before any control command
Does not run herdr workspace, pane, or agent commands

evals.prompt: Use Herdr to run just test in a sibling pane. HERDR_ENV=1, HERDR_PANE_ID=w1:p1, and the caller pane is wide. Keep my focus here.
evals.expected_output: Split the current pane to the right with --cwd and --no-focus, read the new pane id from the JSON result, then pane run and wait. Do not close panes you did not create.
expectations: Uses herdr pane split --current --direction right --cwd and --no-focus
Reads the new pane id from the JSON response
Does not close workspaces, tabs, or panes it did not create
Does not run herdr server stop
